summary: Iron golems produce walking particles for barrier blocks
description:
## The Bug

When anything other than iron golems walk on barriers, walk particles don't appear. This makes sense since the block is invisible. What doesn't make sense is the fact that when an iron golem walks on a barrier block, red walk particles appear when I don't think they should.

## Steps to Reproduce

 - Switch into creative mode, give yourself some barriers, and place them down.

/give @s minecraft:barrier

 - Summon an iron golem on top of the barrier blocks and wait for it to begin walking.

 - Take note as to whether or not iron golems produce walking particles when traveling over barrier blocks.

## Observed Behavior

Iron golems produce walking particles when traveling over barrier blocks.

## Expected Behavior

Iron golems would not produce walking particles when traveling over barrier blocks.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Switch to Creative mode.
2. Give yourself barrier blocks using `/give @s minecraft:barrier`.
3. Place the barrier blocks in an area.
4. Summon an iron golem on top of the barrier blocks using `/summon minecraft:iron_golem ~ ~1 ~`.
5. Wait until the iron golem begins walking.
6. Observe the iron golem while it travels over the barrier blocks.
7. Observe that red walking particles appear as the iron golem walks over the barrier blocks.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.14, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 3, 1.15.1, 1.16.2, 20w51a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w06a, 21w07a, 21w08b, 21w10a, 21w20a, 1.17 Release Candidate 2, 1.17, 1.17.1, 21w41a, 1.18.1, 1.18.2, 22w12a, 1.19, 1.19.1 Pre-release 1, 1.19.2, 1.19.3, 23w05a (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: When an iron golem walks across barrier blocks, red barrier particles are generated at its feet as it moves. The particles appear even though the barrier block itself is invisible. Other entities walking across the same barrier blocks do not produce walking particles.
Expected Behavior: When an iron golem walks across barrier blocks, no walking particles should be produced, just as they are not produced when other entities travel over these invisible blocks. The golem should continue moving normally across the barriers without displaying the red walk-particle effect, preserving the unobtrusive visual behavior expected for barrier blocks.
